description.narrative:
Global objective: Humanitarian and development aid organisations are assisted in fulfilling their own mandates through the provision of essential safety cooperation, information and support services.
Specific objective: NGOs improve their awareness of the context and identify their own vulnerabilities in order to mitigate the risks for the safety of their staff and premises and improve access to their beneficiaries.

Insatsen är ett institutionellt stöd ("core support") som syftar till att stärka kapaciteten hos den icke-statliga organisationen "International NGO Safety Organisation/INSO" i DRK för att ge information och utbildning till icke-statliga och icke vinstdrivande humanitära och utvecklingsorganisationer så att dessa kan arbeta mer effektivt och med mindre risk i konfliktmiljöer. Det institutionella stödet innebär att INSO får flexibilitet att använda den svenska finansieringen för aktiviteter som saknar finansiering från andra givare men som är viktiga för att uppnå programmets mål.
Det totala finansiella stödet uppgår till 4,5 miljoner svenska kronor (SEK) och ges under en treårsperiod från 1 januari 2021 tom 31 december 2023.

The initiative is an institutional support ("core support") aimed at strengthening the capacity of the non-governmental "International NGO Safety Organization / INSO" in DRC to provide information and training to non-governmental and non-profit humanitarian and development organizations in Eastern DRC so that these can work with less risk and thus more effectively in conflict environments. As such, INSO in DRC helps these organisations to fulfil their mandates and to understand the operating environment, which in turn enables access and increased presence in hard-to-reach areas. The institutional support can be used by INSO with flexibility in order to fund activities that lack funding from other donors but are essential for achieving the program's objectives.
The total financial support is amounted to 4.5 million SEK and is given during the 3-year activity period, 1 January 2021 - 31 December 2023.

Overall, INSO played a critical role in supporting NGOs' access to accurate security information and coordination during a challenging period, particularly amid the M23 crisis.INSOs activities, which focus on providing security information to NGOs, were successfully delivered on time, even during the peak of the M23 crisis. The evaluation covers the full year of 2023 and evaluates the implementation of INSO's (International NGO Safety Organisation) services in DR Congo
Key achievements and performance:
- Geographical Coverage:INSO operated in four regions: North Kivu, South Kivu, Ituri, and Tanganyika.
- Core Services:
- Flash Reporting: 1155 alerts and updates.
- Security Reports: 159 reports and updates.
- Weekly Roundtables: 208 regional security meetings.
- Directors' Meetings: 12 held.
- Weekly Incident Lists: 52 lists.
- Biweekly Analytical Reports: 24 reports.
- Quarterly Data Reports: 4 issued.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
